title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
abstract: arXiv:2610.21565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-device deployment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly adopted due to latency and privacy requirements, but exposes proprietary models to reverse engineering and intellectual property theft. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation for on-device inference, yet most TEE-based parameter obfuscation relies on unilateral matrix transformations that obfuscate only output side. We identify a vulnerability in this design, termed the \emph{Solution Determinacy Property (SDP)}: the obfuscation secret is uniquely determined, exposing the structure of the true key and enabling attackers to break the protection. translated_title: BiShield-TEE：论设备端TEE防护LLM分区中单向权重混淆的（不）安全性
translated_abstract: 由于延迟和隐私需求，大型语言模型（LLM）的设备端部署日益普及，但这使专有模型面临逆向工程和知识产权盗窃的风险。可信执行环境（TEE）为设备端推理提供了硬件强制的隔离，然而大多数基于TEE的参数混淆方法依赖于单向矩阵变换，仅对输出侧进行混淆。我们识别出该设计中的一种漏洞，称之为“解确定性属性”：混淆密钥是唯一确定的，这暴露了真实密钥的结构，使攻击者能够破解保护。在我们的攻击下，代表性方法GroupCover和ArrowCloak的保护效果降低至可忽略不计，攻击准确率达到完全防护黑盒基线的2.4倍以上，并能恢复近乎完整的模型功能。为解决该漏洞，我们提（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了设备端TEE防护LLM分区中单向权重混淆方案存在的“解确定性属性”漏洞——混淆密钥唯一确定导致GroupCover、ArrowCloak等方法的保护可被攻击完全破解，并据此提出BiShield-TEE双向防护方案以修复该安全缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Solution Determinacy Property (SDP) vulnerability in unilateral weight obfuscation for TEE-shielded on-device LLM partitions—where uniquely determined obfuscation secrets allow attacks to fully break defenses like GroupCover and ArrowCloak—and proposes BiShield-TEE as a bidirectional countermeasure.
